panels.title: Experiment Comparison
panels.description: Completed benchmark runs and cost profiles. Use this table to compare concurrency, model-serving configuration, run duration, and infrastructure cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    run_id AS "Run ID",
    profile_id AS "Cost Profile",
    profile_name AS "Profile Name",
    profile_version AS "Profile Version",
    dataset_mode AS "Dataset",
    selected_query_count AS "Queries",
    benchmark_concurrency AS "Concurrency",
    model AS "Model",
    max_num_seqs AS "Max vLLM Sequences",
    total_run_cost_usd AS "Total Cost (USD)",
    request_cost_sum_usd AS "Request Cost Sum (USD)",
    duration_seconds AS "Duration (s)"
FROM experiment_cost_comparison
ORDER BY run_id DESC, profile_id;

panels.title: Agent Cost Breakdown
panels.description: Per-agent execution work, latency, failures, attributed infrastructure cost, and percentage of total run cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    run_id AS "Run ID",
    profile_id AS "Cost Profile",
    agent AS "Agent",
    calls AS "Calls",
    cpu_seconds AS "CPU Time (s)",
    wall_time_ms AS "Wall Time (ms)",
    p95_latency_ms AS "p95 Latency (ms)",
    attributed_cost_usd AS "Attributed Cost (USD)",
    cost_percentage AS "Cost Share (%)",
    failures AS "Failures"
FROM agent_cost_breakdown
ORDER BY run_id DESC, profile_id, agent;

panels.title: Per-Query Workload / Cost
panels.description: Request-level workload shape, latency, success state, and attributed cost. This connects query complexity to observed performance and cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    r.run_id AS "Run ID",
    c.profile_id AS "Cost Profile",
    r.query_id AS "Query ID",
    r.n_holdings AS "Holdings",
    r.lookback_days AS "Lookback (days)",
    r.phrasing AS "Phrasing",
    r.client_latency_ms AS "Client Latency (ms)",
    c.total_cost_usd AS "Query Cost (USD)",
    c.success AS "Success"
FROM requests r
JOIN request_cost_attributions c
  ON c.run_id = r.run_id
 AND c.request_id = r.request_id
ORDER BY r.run_id DESC, c.profile_id, r.query_id;
